name: config-string-previews
goal: Show decoded configuration strings inline, ellipsizing long and multiline text while retaining source-safe inspection for collections and computed expressions.

evidence: Decoded string literals must show their beginning inline and ellipsize within the value cell. Collections and computed expressions retain source-safe inspection. Source review identifies ConfigValue gating strings on valueMark; browser reproduction awaits the released validation window.

PR79 typed-value coverage excluded archivePath from decoded literal metadata, so the standard groups matrix tested its source-inspection path instead of a long string. Strengthen entityConfigFixtures, entityPreviewConfigs, the catalog screen test and the static parser matrix; preserve existing computed-expression and collection assertions. Local Harness fixture-review guidance now requires type and source-provenance partitions.
